How custom orders work

1. You set the sizeSliders only allow sizes I know are strong and buildable.
2. I review itI check the cut list, wood availability, and price.
3. I send a quoteYou confirm, pay a deposit, and I start cutting.
4. I build and deliverPickup or delivery once it's finished.

About me

Shep Kegley

University of Colorado BoulderEnvironmental DesignCreative Technology & Design minor

Hello! My name is Shep Kegley, and I'm a student at the University of Colorado Boulder pursuing a bachelor's degree in Environmental Design, with an emphasis in Environmental Products of Design, and a minor in Creative Technology & Design.

Feel free to pitch ideas and request designs that aren't listed on this website. I'd be happy to work with you to craft the next piece for your home.
